Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE Khue walking animation frame, not a sheet.
Image 1: approved Khue left-facing sprite, EDIT TARGET and appearance reference.
Image 2: current frame's technical mannequin, authoritative limb geometry and near/far shading guide.
Image 3: eight-pose motion storyboard, CONTEXT ONLY, not output layout. Read left-to-right top row 0..3 then bottom row 4..7. Silhouette opens, contracts, passes narrow, opens again, then repeats on opposite limbs.
Keep the approved head, face, hair, ivory shirt, jade tie, navy trousers, brown satchel, camera, scale and canvas placement of image 1. Edit the legs and swinging arms to match image 2. Do not keep its neutral legs.
NEAR visible leg is lighter navy and drawn over FAR leg at overlaps. FAR leg stays darker navy, including when it swings forward. Near arm likewise overlaps far arm. Shade using distance from camera, not forward/back position. Flat approved palette, no glow.
Critical motion: the shoe separation and knee bend MUST match the current diagram. Arms swing opposite legs, approaching torso in narrow poses and opening in wide poses. Two plausible continuous legs, not a static spread posture in every frame.
Output exactly one full-body LEFT-facing sprite on 2:3 fully transparent canvas. Same head/torso location, no independent centering or zooming. Hard opaque square logical pixels, 32x48 native target. No diagram colors, ground line, labels, shadows, grid, soft halo, extra frames, scenery or new costume.

TARGET FRAME 0/7: MAXIMUM OPEN stride. Near lighter leg reaches down-left to front shoe, far darker leg down-right to rear shoe. Near arm swings BACK/right, far arm FORWARD/left.
